Rz puts an LHP zero near 2×GBW to recover phase from p2≈60 MHz, giving PM≈70-80°. Current budget: 10 µA ref + 24 µA tail + 120 µA output ≈ 154 µA (≈277 µW). SR=24 V/µs. PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (16.0, 10.0, 20.0),
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 2.0),
    "Itail": (24e-6, 12e-6, 50e-6),
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.5e-12),
    "I7":    (120e-6, 60e-6, 140e-6),
    "gmid7": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "gmidn": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "fzr":   (2.0, 1.0, 5.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    # input pair (source ~0.2 V -> body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It/2, vds=0.55, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load and PMOS CS output: same gm/Id and L -> same Vgs, so I7/I3 is set by W ratio
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], It/2, vds=m3_vds if False else 0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias: reference diode, tail, and output sink all share gm/Id and L
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # compensation: the zero at fz = fzr*GBW in the LHP
    gbw = m1.gm/(2*PI*Cc)
    Rz = 1.0/m7.gm + 1.0/(2*PI*p["fzr"]*gbw*Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)   # inverting-side device drives the diode
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # polarity: vinp up -> o1 down -> vout up (non-inverting)
    A1 = m1.gm/(m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm/(m7.gds + m8.gds)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m7.cgd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm*Cc/(C1*C2 + Cc*(C1 + C2))/(2*PI)
    fz = 1.0/(2*PI*Cc*(Rz - 1.0/m7.gm))
    p3 = 1.0/(2*PI*Rz*C1)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw/p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(gbw/fz)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw/p3))
    power = 1.8*(iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It/Cc, I7/(cl + Cc))
    vov8 = 2.0/p["gmidn"]; vov7 = 2.0/p["gmid7"]
    swing = 1.8 - vov8 - vov7
    cmrr = db(2*m1.gm*m3.gm/(m3.gds*m5.gds) / max(1.0, 1.0)) if False else db(A1*2*m1.gm/m5.gds/ (m1.gm/m3.gm) )
    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A1*A2), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
        "slew": slew, "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": min(cmrr, 100),
        "psrr_db": db(A1*A2) - 3, "settle": 4.6/(2*PI*gbw) + 1.0/slew*0.5,
    }
